pricing.headline: Never miss a new story
pricing.subline: A new AI-illustrated children’s book every day, in 4 languages – for multilingual families who want to open up the world to their kids.
pricing.noticeCancelled: Subscription cancelled – you haven’t been charged.
pricing.noticeAlreadySubscribed: You already have an active subscription – manage it in your profile.
pricing.noticeUnavailable: Subscribing isn’t possible right now. Please try again later.
pricing.featureKeep: Yours to keep in your library
pricing.vatNote: All prices include VAT – 14-day free trial with your first subscription. Cancel any time.
pricing.faqCancelA: Yes, any time, with no minimum term. Go to “Manage subscription” in your profile and cancel in a few clicks – your subscription then runs until the end of the period you’ve paid for.
pricing.faqLanguagesA: Every book is available in four languages: English, German, Arabic and French. You can switch between them whenever you like.
pricing.faqAgeQ: What age are the books for?
pricing.faqAgeA: Kibuka is made for children aged 3 to 10. Our AI writes age-appropriate stories with simple language and colourful illustrations.
pricing.faqTrialA: Yes! Your first subscription starts with a 14-day free trial. You add a payment method when you sign up, but you won’t be charged until the trial ends – cancel before then and you pay nothing.
pricing.faqDevicesQ: Which devices can I use Kibuka on?
pricing.faqDevicesA: Kibuka works on all modern devices: in your web browser, on iPhone/iPad and on Android. Your books go wherever you go.
